content.short: Duel Duck is a prediction platform running on blockchain.
content.description: On-chain prediction services that rely on exchange trading can be opaque to everyday users. Duel Duck delivers a clearer experience with straightforward, easy-to-understand mechanics, commission rewards, and automatic payouts once each duel ends. There are no hidden fees, and every operation is recorded on a transparent smart contract that you can audit or track at any time. Participants contribute predictions about what will happen next in sports, crypto, and gaming industries, with results and outcomes verifiable on-chain.
